families.label: Merchant webhook delivery (payout.* via Stork)
families.description: Every payout state change that a merchant learns about asynchronously: payouts builds a ProcessEventPayload, calls Stork WebhookAPI/ProcessEvent, and Stork fans out one HMAC-signed POST per matching Subscription. At-least-once, no ordering guarantee, no dedupe: the merchant must dedupe on X-Razorpay-Event-Id.

families.label: Payout pricing (fees/tax) and the free-payout allowance
families.description: Fee resolution on payout create and the free-payout counter that zeroes it. Default path: a Redis cache pre-populated by the monolith, falling back to a live POST /payouts_service/fetch_pricing_info; only when the charge_collections_call experiment is on does the ccSdk (Charge Collections + Governor rule chains) resolve the fee instead. free_payout fee_type always uses the monolith call. The free-payout counter lives in PS's own counters table and is mirrored to the monolith's counters table (monthly IST reset, row-locked).

families.label: Feature flags and experiments (DCS + Splitz)
families.description: Every payouts behaviour toggle: DCS config objects under rzp/x/merchant/payouts/* (protobuf-typed, per-merchant, fieldmask-redacted, BigCache 15s) and Splitz experiments resolved per merchant id. Both fail OFF: a DCS fetch error substitutes an empty FeatureMap, and Splitz GetVariantOrDefault returns variant 'default' with result 'off'.

families.label: Fund-account validation (FAV / penny testing)
families.description: The api monolith owns the merchant-facing FAV entity; ValidX executes the actual verification (pennydrop/penniless/paisadrop/upi_intent) across FTS, Citi (via Mozart), the monolith and Slice, then reports back either by Stork (fund_account.validation.completed/failed, DCS Stork.enable_stork) or by POSTing /v1/fund_accounts/validations_internal/webhook, plus an SQS dual-write. Payouts itself has NO synchronous FAV gate and never calls ValidX -- its own FAV module calls the monolith at /fund_accounts/validations_internal/pennydrop.

families.label: Payout links
families.description: payout-links creates a payout through the api monolith's /v1/payouts_internal with an X-Payout-Idempotency header and learns the outcome from the monolith's twirp UpdatePayoutLinkStatus push, mapping payout status onto 8 payout-link statuses and emitting payout_link.* merchant webhooks through Stork.

families.label: Vendor payments and tax payments
families.description: vendor-payments creates payouts on the monolith (/v1/payouts_internal/, /v1/payouts/2fa/create_internal) with X-Dashboard-User-Id + X-Payout-Idempotency, receives status through twirp PayoutStatusChange under a Redis lock (duplicate pushes rejected), and the resulting payout status is republished on the Kafka prod.x.vendor-payments.accounting-payouts.status-update topic that accounting-integrations consumes.
